answer.reason: The verses tell one event of this city, which is also called Debir and Kirjathsepher: its capture by Othniel.

clauses.english: was taken by Othniel, Caleb's brother, when Caleb offered his daughter to whoever took it
clauses.quote: Othniel the son of Kenaz, the brother of Caleb, took it

doubts: The marked verses JOS 15:15-16 and JDG 1:11-12 give the older name Kirjathsepher; JOS 15:49 says Kirjathsannah is Debir, so the story was assigned to this record by that identification.
JOS 15:49 is only a list of towns, so no clause rests on it alone.
